theorems.name: Submission.ted_lpm_fcm_cmd_radial_integrable
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (y : Amb n ℓ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (S T t : ℝ), μ (closedBall y S) < ⊤ → Continuous g → (∀ u : ℝ, T < u → g u = 0) → 0 < t → T * t < S → Integrable (fun x => g (‖x - y‖ / t)) μ
